item.title: Show HN: Find someone in the dark – light them or light yourself? (Three.js)
item.description:
📝 js experiment comparing two simplified strategies: Sweep searchlight: the rescuer moves through an expanding search pattern and must illuminate the missing person. Raise beacon: the rescuer stays put while a mobile missing person tries to recognize and approach an omnidirectional light. Injured makes the stationary beacon ineffective because the missing person cannot approach it.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/skorotkiewicz/signal-in-the-dark
